name: za.co.autoinspect/sa-vehicle
title: Auto Inspect — South African vehicle checks
description: South African vehicle checks: VIN, licence disc, number plate, roadworthy stations, report checks

tools.name: vehicle_vin_check
tools.description: Checks a vehicle identification number (VIN): length and allowed characters, the country and (for common makes sold in South Africa) the manufacturer from the first characters, the possible model years from the 10th character, and the North American check digit. Deterministic — no lookup of the vehicle itself.

tools.name: sa_licence_disc_status
tools.description: South African vehicle licence disc: is it valid, in the 21-day period of grace, or expired — and, when expired, an estimate of the late-renewal penalty (most provinces charge 10% of the licence fee for every month or part of a month late after the grace period; provinces differ). Give the expiry date printed on the disc, and the licence fee if known.

licence_fee_zar.description: Optional: the annual licence fee in rand (on the renewal notice). Without it the penalty is given as a percentage.

as_of.description: Optional: date to check on, YYYY-MM-DD (default today, South African time).

tools.name: sa_number_plate_check
tools.description: Which South African province a number plate format points to (e.g. "… GP" Gauteng, "CA …" Western Cape, "N… / … ZN" KwaZulu-Natal, "… L" Limpopo). Format only — it does not look the vehicle up.

plate.description: The number plate as written, e.g. "HD 60 GY GP" or "CA 123-456".

tools.name: sa_find_test_stations
tools.description: Finds vehicle testing stations (roadworthy / COF) in South Africa from the official provincial registers in the Auto Inspect directory, by town, area, province or name. Returns the station, town, province, phone where published, and the Auto Inspect booking page.

place.description: Town, suburb, province or station name, e.g. "Vereeniging" or "Western Cape".

tools.name: autoinspect_verify_report
tools.description: Checks whether an Auto Inspect inspection, intake or hand-over report is genuine and unchanged, from the verification code printed on the report (also at autoinspect.co.za/v/<code>). Returns only what the public check page shows: genuine or not, report type, date and the business that issued it.

code.description: The verification code from the report (8–16 letters and digits).
